title: Interpreting Protein Language Model Embeddings via Orthogonal Projection for Protein Fitness Prediction
abstract: arXiv:2608.25548v1 Announce Type: new  Abstract: Recently, there has been a growing adoption of protein language models (PLMs) in biomedical science. Their embeddings provide a rich numerical representation of protein sequences which achieve state-of-the-art performance on several downstream tasks including protein fitness prediction. However, PLM embeddings are not directly interpretable and, thereby, it remains unclear what features they encode. To gain insight into which biochemical properties of the protein are driving the prediction, we leverage an orthogonal projection technique that removes linear effects of known tabular features from embeddings and extend it to high-order and interaction effects. In this way, we remove the effects of interpretable biochemical features from PLM embeddings. translated_title: 通过正交投影解释蛋白质语言模型嵌入用于蛋白质适应性预测
translated_abstract: arXiv:2608.25548v1 公告类型：新 摘要：近期，蛋白质语言模型（PLMs）在生物医学科学中的应用日益广泛。它们的嵌入提供了蛋白质序列的丰富数值表示，在包括蛋白质适应性预测在内的多项下游任务中达到了最先进的性能。然而，PLM嵌入不能直接解释，因此其编码的特征仍不清楚。为了洞察蛋白质的哪些生化特性驱动了预测，我们利用一种正交投影技术，该技术从嵌入中去除已知表格特征的线性效应，并将其扩展到高阶和交互效应。通过这种方式，我们从PLM嵌入中移除了可解释生化特征的影响。在消融研究中，我们表明这导致仅使用嵌入训练的下游分类器预测蛋白质适应性的性能下降。在额外的评估中，
tldr: 本文提出一种正交投影方法，从蛋白质语言模型嵌入中去除可解释生化特征及其高阶交互效应，以揭示预测蛋白质适应性时依赖的关键生化特性。
en_tdlr: This paper proposes an orthogonal projection method to remove interpretable biochemical features and their higher-order interactions from protein language model embeddings, revealing the key biochemical properties driving protein fitness prediction.
